sources.title: Maine Secretary of State, Bureau of Corporations, Elections and Commissions: November 6, 2012 General Election, United States Senate by municipality (xls)
Maine Secretary of State: November 6, 2012 General Election, United States Senate by county (xls)
Maine Secretary of State, Previous Election Results

method: pipeline/patches/2012_ME_SEN.py sums the municipal rows of the official xls within each county block (checked against each block's County Totals row and the separate county file); Dill (Democrat) is dem, Summers (Republican) is rep, and King, Dalton, Dodge and Woods are oth; BLANK votes are excluded. The statewide-only STATE UOCAVA line (Dill 702, Summers 587, others 1,622; 3,029 ballots incl. 118 blank) belongs to no county and is left out.
validation: CSV statewide dem 92,198 / rep 214,812 / oth 390,678 vs certified totals Dill 92,900 / Summers 215,399 (King 370,580): difference -702 (-0.76%) / -587 (-0.27%), exactly the STATE UOCAVA votes left out.
